selection_rationale: The full-data candidate achieves AP=0.806207, which is +0.010304 (approximately +1.3% relative) above the 1M candidate AP=0.795903. ROC-AUC also improved by +0.001949. AP was designated as the primary Phase 5 selection metric. The Brier score is marginally worse (+0.000481), which is documented but does not override the AP improvement. Calibration is a Phase 6 task.
